name: payments
title: Payments
summary: Users pay through hosted Stripe Checkout for one-time purchases and subscriptions, manage billing in the portal and see their history; features gate on entitlements.

env.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
env.doc: Stripe secret key (sk_test_… in development; live keys are refused there). Unset = every payments route answers 503 payments_unconfigured.

env.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
env.doc: Signing secret of the webhook endpoint <PUBLIC_API_URL>/webhooks/stripe. Required outside development when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is set; unset = all webhooks refused. dev-up's payments hook fills it from `stripe listen`.
env.source: dashboard.stripe.com → Developers → Webhooks → endpoint → Signing secret

env.name: STRIPE_CONNECT_WEBHOOK_SECRET
env.doc: Signing secret of a second endpoint (same URL) that listens to events on connected accounts; needed for account.updated with PAYMENTS_CONNECT_ENABLED.
env.source: dashboard.stripe.com → Developers → Webhooks → Connect endpoint → Signing secret

env.name: PAYMENTS_PRICES
env.doc: Development seed for the price catalog: key=price_id[:entitlement],… (e.g. pro_monthly=price_123:pro). cmd/seed upserts them with Stripe's real amounts; production uses the admin catalog.

env.name: PAYMENTS_CONNECT_ENABLED
env.doc: Turn on Stripe Connect: users onboard Express accounts and prices can send their money to one (destination charges).

env.name: PAYMENTS_PLATFORM_FEE_BPS
env.doc: Platform fee on Connect destination charges, in basis points (250 = 2.5%), 0 to 10000.

env.name: PAYMENTS_RETENTION_YEARS
env.doc: Years a deleted account's orders, ledger and refunds are kept pseudonymised before they and the Stripe customer are deleted (US 7, UK 6, DE/FR 10).

env.name: PAYMENTS_RETURN_PATHS
env.doc: Comma-separated web path prefixes that checkout success/cancel and portal return paths must start with.

env.name: PAYMENTS_RENEWAL_GRACE
env.doc: How long a renewing subscription's entitlement outlasts its period end while the renewal is confirmed (Go duration). Scheduled cancellations end exactly at their date.

env.name: PAYMENTS_SHIPPING_COUNTRIES
env.doc: Physical goods: two-letter ISO country codes (US,CA) Checkout collects a shipping address for; the order stores it. Empty = no address asked.

env.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_PAYMENTS_MOBILE_CHECKOUT
env.doc: on = the app opens Stripe Checkout and the billing portal in an in-app browser. Only for physical goods and services: digital goods in the app need Apple/Google in-app purchase (FEATURE.md → The store rule).

stitch: Classify what you sell (FEATURE.md → The store rule): physical goods and services use this module; digital content or features used in the iOS/Android app need Apple/Google in-app purchase (not in this module), so keep EXPO_PUBLIC_PAYMENTS_MOBILE_CHECKOUT off unless the catalog is physical goods or services.
Create products and prices in Stripe, then add each to the catalog (Admin → Payments → Prices, or PAYMENTS_PRICES in .env.dev) with a stable key and the entitlement it grants.

Gate paid features with payments.RequireEntitlement("<entitlement>") on routes (402 payment_required); in clients call usePaymentRequired() in onError to open the plan picker, and link pricing to /payments (web) or /payments/plans (mobile).

Selling per item (tickets, orders)? Call payments.From(d).Checkout with a Ref from your own endpoint, react in payments.OnOrder hooks (inside the webhook transaction), check with payments.HasPaidOrder. Physical goods: set PAYMENTS_SHIPPING_COUNTRIES and read order.Shipping in the hook.

Production: add the endpoint <PUBLIC_API_URL>/webhooks/stripe in Stripe with the events in FEATURE.md, set STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, configure the Billing Portal, and name Stripe as a processor in the privacy policy.
Development: put a test-mode STRIPE_SECRET_KEY in .env.dev and install the Stripe CLI; dev-up's payments hook forwards webhooks.
